Friend,

We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy.

The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded.

**At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong.**

We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation.

I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down.

I know you won't either!

I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation.

clean_body: Friend, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're Marxists. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. Leftists focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftists destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. Your support will help Landmark Legal Foundation live up to its motto of " Defending Liberty, Fighting Tyranny." Thank you in advance for actively joining the fight! God Bless, Mark Levin Chairman Emeritus Landmark Legal Foundation Landmark Legal Foundation is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

body:
It’s understating things by a lot to say the last 14 years have been an uphill battle. When Gabby founded this organization the NRA and the gun lobby were ascendant.
#

Friend, Emma Brown here.
I wanted to touch base and level with you about where we are as an organization after the elections this week, because the results have required us to take another look at our plans in the weeks, months, and years ahead.
Full disclosure: We didn’t expect this.
It’s understating things by a lot to say the last 14 years have been an uphill battle. When Gabby founded this organization the NRA and the gun lobby were ascendant. They had virtually unlimited resources and a bench of candidates in every state, and at every level of government.
The fact that GIFFORDS has passed more than 820 gun safety laws in the years since is, frankly, incredible. But, even in our most optimistic forecasts, we expected that we’d still need to be ready for the same kind of fights next year.
As I write to you now, there will be at least 54 Democrats in the United States Senate in 2027. 234 Democrats in the House — and counting. Democrats made historic gains in state houses, breaking up super majorities and flipping chambers. Next year, 29 states will have Democratic governors.
So, I’m going to ask you to do something here. I’m asking you to consider what we have already accomplished, even as we had to fight tooth and nail for every inch of ground. And then I’m asking you to imagine what is possible now. Today.
We'll continue to be in touch as plans come together for next year, but I was hoping to be one of the first to ask you to pledge your support as we make those plans. We're still going to need a lot of help, and that starts with you.
**[So, please: Will you make a donation to GIFFORDS so we can hit the ground running in 2027? There is still so much to do, and we can't do it without you.](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261107-1-B&t=1&akid=12008%2E3935704%2EVOB8C6)**

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: The first call I received
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I remember thinking how many others had probably gotten the same call, both in Arizona and around the country.
#

I’ll never forget this.
When I was first elected to the Arizona House of Representatives, one of the first calls I received was from the NRA. They told me they couldn’t wait to work with me, how excited they were to build a partnership, and how much support I’d get from them.
I remember thinking about how many others had probably gotten the same call, both in Arizona and around the country.
I look back on that now, having spent the last 14 years building an organization that would stand up to the NRA, their candidates, and the grip they had on our politics.
I know how many candidates and elected leaders get calls from GIFFORDS now, because I am the one making those calls. I know the courage it takes to stand with us, to choose to take action to protect your constituents. And I know that none of it would happen without you.
This is an organization that runs almost entirely on grassroots support. People who care, people who are willing to do something for change. And I am incredibly grateful for you. Because of you, we have an unprecedented opportunity to pass gun safety legislation over the next two years — even in states we never thought possible.
It is going to require a ton of work, and a ton of resources. It is going to be difficult. But it is possible. That is why I am writing, and it is why I am humbly asking you:
**[Please, make a donation to GIFFORDS as we prepare for what may be the most active year in the history of our organization. $3, or anything you can afford. These gifts will add up fast if enough people chip in, and that’s what we need to make the most of this opportunity.](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261108-1-B&t=1&akid=12009%2E3935704%2ELY8y9q)**

name: Jane Fonda
subject: All eyes on Texas! 👀
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=21%2E6803%2EQTn07A)
[](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261108-ak.51A7aA&refcode=20261108-21&t=3&akid=21%2E6803%2EQTn07A)
We’re still celebrating Tuesday’s historic wins. I’m walking on air, light as a feather, breathing easier. I’m so proud of us, the American people, for proving so decisively we do not tolerate corruption, cruelty, and crimes.
Now there’s one race I need to talk to you about because it didn’t get sufficient attention in the “**BLEXAS** ” wave: **Congresswoman-elect Katy Padilla Stout (TX-23).**
[](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261108-ak.51A7aA&refcode=20261108-21&t=4&akid=21%2E6803%2EQTn07A)
Texas’ 23rd district stretches hundreds of miles along the US-Mexico border and encompasses one of our country’s most precious natural spaces: Big Bend National Park.
Trump and his polluter allies had their sights set on tearing right through it with bulldozers and border walls — threatening wildlife, fragile ecosystems, and the Rio Grande. And Katy’s opponent, right-wing gun influencer Brandon Herrera, was ready to rubber-stamp that destruction all while chasing YouTube clicks for his own benefit.
But this past Tuesday, the people of South and West Texas said heck no and rejected the low-effort agenda Brandon and Trump offered.
**Instead, they elected Katy – the first Latina to represent San Antonio and Texas’s 23rd Congressional District in the United States Congress. Wow.**
As a former kindergarten teacher and child welfare attorney, she ran unapologetically to protect her community, defend our public lands, and hold corporate interests accountable. **This district was once considered “deep red” – one that Donald Trump won by 15 points in 2024.**
But Texans made their voices heard loud and clear. And with Katy in Congress, I know she’ll faithfully carry her constituents' voices to Washington from the second she sets foot in Congress.
She’s already proving so:
[](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261108-ak.51A7aA&refcode=20261108-21&t=5&akid=21%2E6803%2EQTn07A)
That’s my kind of woman! Nothing gives me more hope than seeing our endorsed candidates waste no time holding the crooks accountable.
That’s exactly why I started JanePAC: to recruit, support, and elect leaders like Katy with the moral courage to fight like hell for our communities and our planet. We proved what people power can accomplish in TX-23 — and this is something we can achieve _everywhere._
Thank you for restoring hope.
In solidarity,
xx Jane
**Before you go...** I couldn’t be prouder of this grassroots movement. But Big Oil isn’t going to roll over and take their losses on the chin. Our newly elected leaders need us behind them on Day One to hold the line. **[So, as we celebrate these wins, can I count on you to throw in any amount to help us protect our victories and elect more leaders like Katy to Congress?](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261108-ak.51A7aA&refcode=em20261108-21&t=6&akid=21%2E6803%2EQTn07A)** **[Donate ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261108-ak.51A7aA&refcode=20261108-21&t=7&akid=21%2E6803%2EQTn07A)**

Dear Patriot,

You may not know me personally, but you've probably seen my work.

My name is James O'Keefe. For more than 15 years, I've carried hidden cameras into places the powerful don't want you to see. I founded Project Veritas, and today I run O'Keefe Media Group.

On October 28, Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty announced felony charges against me in Minnesota for unlawful voting and identity theft. Together, the two counts carry up to 10 years in prison and $20,000 in fines.

At the same press conference, she said this:
“I think it's pretty clear they did not intend to vote.”

And then: “Whether or not they intended to vote is irrelevant.”

I'm writing to you because I need help, and I need it fast.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABACJmnNMqok7XJ1SrvK3fj0XyU32eQVWMewAs1bJwkvw8wie64Ut7KlnTb69NxbRBGnkL4u_MkBPODUccQR36-Nd5AkeYoiC6PxbXPZE

Here is what happened.

On August 11, the day of Minnesota's primary, my team took hidden cameras into Minneapolis polling places to document how the state's voter “vouching” law works. Under that law, a registered voter can vouch for up to eight people who show up to register without the usual proof of address.

Election workers explained it to us on camera. One said: “You're the ID.”

Then we left. We never signed an oath. We never received a ballot. We never voted. The prosecutor agrees we “stopped short of signing the oath.”

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABACJmnNNo9rJU6To_I93cAXN1uoRGuj72G-mjGZExiR41pdXUXWuUTVSB0TDdyevGQ5P4izEvUEDJ1sbUmL_TimPVIT25Zt5QELKSdtF

Her case is that answering an election judge's questions was the start of “a multi-step process” of applying for a ballot, an idea the complaint pulls from the Secretary of State's election manual.

Testing whether a system can be abused is not the same as abusing it.

She called it “a low level offense.” And she still held a press conference about it six days before a national election.

She also said: “There is no such thing as undercover investigation in the polling place.”

I've been sued more times than I can count. Police once walked into my newsroom and took my guns. One case took me nine years to win, all the way to a federal appeals court.

Every time, the goal is the same. If they can't beat the footage, they try to bury the reporter in court.

This time it isn't money on the line. It's a felony record.

A felony defense in another state means Minnesota lawyers, travel for every court date, motions, transcripts, and maybe a trial. And every hour I spend in a courtroom is an hour I'm not in the field.

Patriot, I don't ask lightly. I'm asking now.

## Neighbors Help Flood Recovery Efforts
Water, shovels, and cash are headed to Copperhill after flash flooding [damaged 45 homes and 42 businesses in Polk County](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7SAMB_CnSTaOgHwPDHc527lrx8gBE5AciIAmyttXOW2foIMX27L-P3-85hd48mH9DxuqUuwc8MyEpWCaLcVoEup4YLpMJLrOGI0lP0sueyYE4-MMuvgD5xZqoxYpJmh1jUoMUyuaXsi-dgpl20k9Sm6xAS4sh0b0XTMOXWM0dLL26j4oBB_vapvH0NlF8GWQ42S17UTVcjS-xPQoDguGgDkjWrruaA8dt5qUK2XPVfOvks9KPm-GdhAC0nQv_LS-ZcyAp6uSz18cW3D1ITOw9_Tt9mFlBg_IBQpmpuO-Y3KeiG1aw5UPT4TMYcLMXDzZFT-ZhsAc0l4nZfbTE_ncD1XL1w08vWOWP_74UPIrAAD__-hVlmg). Torrential rain sent the Ocoee River [to a record 18.05 feet Thursday](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpSAQRp8GO4wgKhYU29jdbbc0CINOgnIDs5L79htvsS_wF1PNl5OT8-e1vixGvPbf9gRDFNYLaolABHkNMSWfwaUb8senGD81JR8irrKTIxeCd3q1jvCGVdnGm02K2SrXgBHTrEQ_Cjk2hxnc0IPQelSz09qFHjY1T5Pbxnmb9eQbNA9QiE4_p_p2GsImum2Seg4uDIKpDjxSyi0dQHBdUApAiJ9HrXXpbKI5iN6F9b-YXJhcaq1tLef9PJlcHj6TixBMLt3A5LKnm0cAXsgS8BQCOrSx8AzlnS7PDyyUMjr-jYDXzinjvkP-TtxfKPy_B5NLk41_V4wRyzgx1e2nxfgVox9WvY38FwAA___q6Y4u), topping a mark set in 1990. Swift-water teams rescued more than 100 people and 25 dogs across Tennessee and Georgia. ## Virginia Beach Tourism Tops $4 Billion
Tourism had a [$4 billion economic impact](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2PozAQhn-N6YzsYTBQuLiGLtdeiSZmCCMZHIEPlH-_IspWW245H3r0Pu-_23AjibI-_tLCPh_TsPK5R86Zt-HOFOac_m-yL_eUlp3WMKdtnwYw4LS12rQDhSwHD0jF6CdCpq5gb5sObeUqrIvZB1c12E0tggnoptrY0DYEo3WMODZciL941prWWgtQldCOzmFLbWfHusag0PAoOW1lnvmQ7SGr0BRf6eCtDGkpop9zfu6q-qOgV9Cf51medLyuo4L-clLQxxQo6s_wjdFvyx8L_fHWs2SN-i4xSlo1h7SmRYKW5Ukha1k1GKgV9MXmx-d5ve2uUWgeC0l8h8u_7PXw8BUAAP__JyyOZQ) in Virginia Beach in 2025, according to a report Visit Virginia Beach released Thursday. The city drew 14.4 million visitors, up 0.6% from 2024, and they spent an average of $7.2 million a day. Tourism supported 34,704 jobs, nearly one in five in the city, and generated $352.3 million in state and local taxes. That's up from a [$3.9 billion impact](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAQRU9jOpBtbDCFizR0mzYlGsywjGTwyp4F5fbRrpITpH_6X-993aYbUKTj_gk7ej7X6cCrRGTGPM0IYeP0zFT2OaW9wBG2lMs6aam7WqlaugkC04mTgWrxKxiEoUKv-sGotmuNrTYvcTHdMMPaSaNma63ue-d6GVywympZkX_tKSWdUkrrttFu6TrjwA1qsdYEYSQuxCk3vOFJ-U4HwRq_04m5CWmvot-YH0W0H0KPQo_XdTUnFeI_-K3yQoUeH5D5wFxnLOmZAxahx8LAWKe1_tUVeqyyXx4XxUil64WR9x0ovt_4n6FOr38CAAD__-6CfvM) in [2024](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb_GdEa2MQ4ULl5Dl9duiQYzwEjGjswEtH-_SrT5gu2Pju65X_fxDhQprf9hR8_nMia8jojMWMYJIWycn4WOfcp5PyCFLZdjGY0yTmotVTdCYDpxtFDNfgGL0Ffo9a23unGNbavNu2Db2XUwaQVm6s0UJlSL7kCB6-ewVORfPq1Vp7U2pqlNNztnO-h6PbetDcIqnIlzqXnDk8pKiWCJ3_nEUoe8V9FvzI9DNP-EGYQZPsy7oF7zKcwQckoYWJjhlSjM8FsmQ05M6YmH5CyXJ0aJIae8U5BryRdvkpL8GOVbKS_iTTaynyRnhihpf0DgF2iUsVXx8-OiGOlwN2HVugPF91D-48enNz8BAAD__wR7lN8), when 14.3 million people visited.
## Richmond Anchor Signs Off after 42 Years
Longtime CBS 6 anchor Cheryl Miller [signed off Friday](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL3upCAUxZ9GOwxfIhYU29jNtluaO3jRm6BMgMXM229msm_wL09Ocj5-fx7rAyjStf-GE11tYb3wLhFrxbw-EfxR099M5XymdBa4_JFyCavk0jAhGLcr-EoNVw395gJohLlHJ6ZZC2WUHvvDhclMAKMOqAR6y62fORpl-IwQhJp7cp88IbgVQkipBmk3Y7QFO4ttHLXvNMeNaspDPbBR3ukiCPGdGubBp7OP7qj1VTr1q5NLJ5f7voe7tq_ZyeXzqZNLTB4i-y_8gfkd2UkxYmaF9quwFAK7UmOGfQb12W2vm2KkYqZO8_0Eit-6-kNSzcl_AQAA__9In34t), ending a 42-year run at the Richmond station she joined in 1984. The Rochester, New York, native began her broadcasting career in 1973 and was inducted into the Silver Circle honor society in 2023. She'll keep hosting ["Battle of the Brains,"](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQQOHTQAfyH44pXGyTLttuiQYz4JEMjswEK7dfba6w9ZO-4v08pgdQomP7hh09X-t0YD0TMmOZZoQQOb8Knfuc837CEWIu5zopoWwnZSfcBIHpwslAu_gVDMLYope30UhttRna6BGUnQFxlMLNWmtnINjBOqFMWJyyLfk_T0rhpJRK6V65xVrjwI1yGQYTGiNwIc6l54gXlY0OgjW984WlD3lvk4_Mz7PRX426N-pea-0rX5_YqDu8OObShYjlnbqdUsLSFr88K6VEp701Rmw7UPpg_M8Pl1e_AQAA__-TnHMu) the high school quiz show she's led since 2003, and will work on special projects for the station. _" So this is not goodbye. It's just so long for now,"_ Miller told viewers.
## Montgomery County Plans 250th Birthday Bash
Montgomery County will celebrate its [250th anniversary](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOhCAQgOGn0U4DAyoWFNdst9deaUYYlQRkg7Ns9u0vd93VV__JV_xf9-WOIYZz_8REluu2nPS6IjFTWVZCd3B-lnClNed04emOXK5tAQFjJ2UnzIKOQ6VFY-vthppwbsnKadZSjUoP7WENKKVgI-HJq3VCqfUAm5kmPa_aDL4N9seTUhgpJYDqwfhx1AbNLP0waNdoQT5wLj0fVEPZwxlwi-9cqfQupzbag_lxNeqjgVsDt5RP3nOi8nb5efK7Yr_n2sBN_omdy13FDgbRFusfrxBjuMap0WJPGOIvzf-8Ui18BwAA__-nsHdo) and Veterans Day with a free event from 2 to 7 p.m. Wednesday in Uptown Christiansburg. The night ends with fireworks and a drone show at 7 p.m. from Huckleberry Park. The county, [formed in 1776](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOpCAUBeCnwQ4DiKgFxTZ2s-2WBvEqd4MwwTs6vv3GfYW_Oc1JvpycP6_p5TBi2n67HSyd65TgOiIQQZlmcD5Q_hQ89jnn_XDJh1yOdVJCGS4lF_3kPOEJk3bVYlenwQ0VWNkNWjam0W0V7LD2HhrjTeeNMNLPq2uUN0q4YXArtBXax5NS9FJKpZpa9Ysxunf9IJe21Z5pAQtSLjUFOLFsmNCt8c4nlNrnvYo2EL0P1vxiamRqvK6rvpb5b_e0TI2Pz9QonpAtUyN831AQkgee4OLwDTgj8YBbiLgFwrTxgAflcvM9J9ryDuXmPn8S3UyNVbHL-8IY8TAd02LbHcb_U-iHL55W_QsAAP__Z0CITA), is named for Revolutionary War Gen. ## U.S., China, Russia Discuss November Meeting
China has confirmed that it is [discussing a historic meeting](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMkbuNrYhcHDJZHPphcjY7cF3xiDTzNzu16_YX9iwVFKV3vvzmB4u5VSev91KluM2FXofmZipTnXz_yhSzlQ9FaYaaD754DqhQN0BdGKYnOf0ognaYCMRkmzJghl7kEYa1S7WQHDeuMH3SgUdvB8o6llJwOjFLGOb7DUHIAYAHKW6gRu1hACeQhBKuaYXFBJv9fZ3S4UXivlje1G9-W1ts12Y96ORvxq8N3h3-0VwVVeonHymBu_7yal0XM917_6n7liofC5UuuNc18SdHpQScg4kxlEDImCcx6CjAd0jUt9WG_Z3yjkd2jS9eK4u5e9__pm1l8WvAAAA___qmYEM) later this month between President Trump, Chinese leader Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin at a regional summit in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. Trump had indicated he is open to three-way [talks focused on nuclear weapons](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ugzAQx5_GbEY-8-EweOjClq4d0cU-glNjkDlC26eviNQn6HY6_fT_-rgOVwwxpPs7zmR5XIZExxaJmfKQF_dJI8VI2VFiyp5uO2-cB610KwGkugzoODxpgMLbkUhTVZAF09VQmco0xWRV1zo0NyLyXa2dc6Yz5uIdeFW3o7sVwZ5yAOoCoLuqKQG7tgIPjrxXTYOiVuQDL7l8LCHxRGP8Xp6US7fMRbQT87qJ6k3oXuj-OI4S4wN_iDKehND92Uno_rQRugcQuj-PY0KWKDnv8yq_glx3Dklu-zwHlseyRy9nwiQxefli_96Ji2z9eoQYw9YaUav7jCG-8vD_Vnxa_RsAAP__b--IOA). At its 1977 peak, one in every five magazines sold in the country was a _TV Guide_. The trick was localization. National feature pages were printed once, then wrapped around more than 140 locally printed listings sections, so the copy on your coffee table was genuinely yours, right down to the UHF station nobody else got. It became a keepsake, not just a schedule. The January 25, 1964 issue carried [_" America's Long Vigil,"_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1u4zAQR_HTUJ0FDqnPgsU26rztlgJ3-KfFhBYNamLFtw-SK-QC7wG_f9f16lNO--2vv8NJLOuO88gQQV1r4XdE5IzK2AU14P-HHFJXo81wIbroafUs6YmVmuAiYGAbOBrnjuxox77ZHPcg6oFxJB6YuQvBgG00PkSaNDfJfeeI9ERkZtu35OfBUiBGCLrvveo0QpJS27eSdtkQ86s8UVsu9ya7TeRxKPtHmUWZ5TzPVjZs2OsrlhraUm_KLFxyBksq-6HMgs9HLhXKLL5Kip5FmcVO2s6mqS48zpRzOoZRdfp29yn_nOR3Pk9nvgIAAP__HyR7nQ) a 27-page record of the four days of Kennedy assassination coverage, introduced by President Johnson, and millions of families saved it. What killed publishing's golden goose? The "Guide" button on the cable box. Hundreds of cable channels made full listings impossible, and on-screen program guides made them unnecessary. Circulation fell from 20 million to 3 million through the 1980s and 1990s. Media mogul Rupert Murdoch had paid $3.2 billion for it in 1988. In October 2008, an SEC filing revealed the magazine's new price: exactly $1, plus roughly $100 million in assumed debt. Though its cultural cachet is gone, it never really died. _TV Guide Magazine_ still publishes from Troy, Michigan, about 24 issues a year, with circulation near 940,000, scheduling grids and all. For roughly three decades, the best-selling magazine in America was a little digest that lived on top of the television set. At its 1977 peak, one in every five magazines sold in the country was a TV Guide. Walter Annenberg launched it nationally on April 3, 1953, for 15 cents, with Lucille Ball's . The trick was localization. National feature pages were printed once, then wrapped around more than 140 locally printed listings sections, so the copy on your coffee table was genuinely yours, right down to the UHF station nobody else got. It became a keepsake, not just a schedule. The January 25, 1964 issue carried a 27-page record of the four days of Kennedy assassination coverage, introduced by President Johnson, and millions of families saved it. And every September, the eagerly awaited Fall Preview issue arrived, twice its normal thickness and often the biggest seller of any magazine in America. Usually the kids got to it first, circling the new shows they wanted to watch like a TV wish book. . What killed publishing's golden goose? The "Guide" button on the cable box. Hundreds of cable channels made full listings impossible, and on-screen program guides made them unnecessary. Circulation fell from 20 million to 3 million through the 1980s and 1990s. Media mogul Rupert Murdoch had paid $3.2 billion for it in 1988. In October 2008, an SEC filing revealed the magazine's new price: exactly $1, plus roughly $100 million in assumed debt. Though its cultural cachet is gone, it never really died. TV Guide Magazine still publishes from Troy, Michigan, about 24 issues a year, with circulation near 940,000, scheduling grids and all. belongs to a company called Fandom. In August 2026 the national debt passed $40 trillion.1 It was not
voted on. There was no ceremony. Most Americans found out from a
headline, if they found out at all.

Somebody has to absorb it

A debt that size does not simply sit there. It gets serviced,
refinanced, and eventually dealt with — and there are only three
ways to deal with it: raise taxes, cut spending, or reduce the real
value of what is owed by letting the currency weaken. The first two
require Congress to do something unpopular on the record. The third
requires nobody to do anything at all.

That is why the figure matters to a retirement account rather than
just to a budget committee. Every dollar in your IRA is a claim
denominated in the same currency the debt is denominated in.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e783889/UaHR0cHM6Ly9vZmZlcnMuYmlzaG9wZ29sZGdyb3VwLmNvbS9kZWJ0Lw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMDg/LbmNsNnZ3UzNlcA/qP3V0bV90ZXJtPURlYnQ0MFQmbGVhZF9zb3VyY2U9ZGVidCZwdWJsaXNoZXI9anBtXQ/gavBpRg/sfo2297ccaf
If the obligation is managed down in real terms, that happens through
your savings, not around them.

The evidence is already behind us. It takes roughly $1.95 today to
buy what a dollar bought in 2000.2 Nothing was confiscated. The unit
was simply worth less each year, and savers holding it carried the
cost quietly.

Gold is the one asset in this conversation with no issuer. No
treasury can print it, no company can dilute it, no counterparty can
default on it. Central banks themselves have been buying more than a
thousand tons a year.3 They are not doing it for the yield.

You are allowed to hold physical gold inside an IRA. Most savers
have never been told that, because the firms holding their money do
not sell it. The free 2026 Gold IRA Guide walks through exactly how a
rollover from an IRA, 401(k) or TSP works, which metals the IRS
allows, how insured depository storage works, and the mistakes that
cost retirees the most. It is free and it takes about thirty seconds
to request.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1f791a8bac39/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7364009?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,I’m still in my robe, running on no sleep, and I can’t wait to talk to you about what Tennessee just did and what comes next!
[**[CLICK HERE to LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/9wfDgFN1Iaf?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
****
[**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/19Dapsav38G?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

When the first early vote numbers dropped in Knox County and I saw the early vote totals for Michaela Barnett, I started crying, because I knew we were seeing something Tennessee hadn't seen before. This week it's just me, walking you through election night: the close calls, the flips, and what the folks who ran as unapologetic progressives showed us about how to win.
I also talk about the [State House pickups](https://us.list-manage.com/dY8WY2OdgYa?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), Knoxville candidates who moved their districts by double digits, why Tennessee doesn't get the national investment Texas and Georgia do, and what we have to demand from the new majorities in Washington: bold leadership, accountability and real help with affordability. Plus the story of the sweetest, most polite postcard that sent Tim Burchett into a tailspin.
We did not win everything. But when we vote, we win, and I'm not done thanking every one of you who knocked a door, made a call and showed up.

Thank you for being here,
Gloria

## Sam Fox Trades Restaurants for Hotels
Phoenix restaurateur Sam Fox [has stepped away from Fox Restaurant Concepts](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkLuunTAQAL8GOh_hB3AoXKShu2lTIoPXYMl4kXfhwP366OYX0o9Go_nzNX25mGJef7sdLLvvMGX4UAJmKJPHjIXIXUDPfmyYH4-ZA5ZJNaoTUormPbmF4wWTcbW3uluG3tRgZT8YabTUpt7sDErJFnrtF2m63gywNP3cShfc8vZyrqP98UnZvKVuWq1e0g9etdrPvZQDDF1lGvCRsbx4A1fiN2YX0oMXlNeCe53sxnxQpX9VaqzUGPN8UsxAdGz3D1GpkYu7IIkEkc4ClRrJ7SLgLWiLgUkEXE4SjCKd91kesSFDEh4uSHjskFkETAk_Ma-iALE7i8ss1oLnIeCOXBfrj09MKVLXV6ZZdxfTvzz-37OXVX8DAAD__7a4lGM), the company he launched with one Tucson restaurant in 1998. Fox stayed on after selling the group to The Cheesecake Factory for [more than $350 million in 2019](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOpDAUg58GuiBy4Vak2Ibu33ZLdEgOQ6SQoOQAwzz9inmFv_skW5btfz_TDzjvwusvbKgJPssU8MoeiTBNNoaYcoYT873tawy3jYGWmCZRi5Zxzup-AkPuxElBabVszdCpEjXvBsWV5FKVqx4sNJ00g-j4LFXf4MIl70W_tEIIMF3p9JPHed1zWTdSVNwOVjTSzh3nAw5toWq0jmKqaEVI7hMDLP6OJ6bKxK30eiXacyH_FGIsxHhdVwWz4c2jFmJ8NhVinI_sAuYHM2xsiW-Gb0f5SwkzwZEgEDMxGNwps8t5z5ZojsxiYGsk9Mwc3gVINzsx0JEwl0nb_XG63HaFql8bOP-tRb999NTifwAAAP___neO6w), and the pandemic kept him longer than planned. Over his run, the company created 22 brands, including Culinary Dropout and Flower Child, and opened 170 restaurants. His last day was Oct. 30, and [he’ll now focus on Author & Edit Hospitality](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuhDAURL8GOlZ-LdiFizR0mzYlutiXxYqxkX2XfXx9lFX-IN1IM5ojna_LdIEQQ7p-woaW4LVMCe81IhGWyeeUS61wYH1u-5rT0-dESy6TYKLvOO-YnsBROHBS0Hore2cG1aLlg1FcSS5Vu9p-cFob49msz0YJxYycZwDNvXbCD7oN9vePc6a5ZGcpTtwbL87SzwPnBk3fKIY-UC4nWhFKeOUES3zmA8vJ5a2NdiXaayM_GjE2YvwmeBeNGP_W3XyrIWGtjRgrbN2SHx0-AtV3KlgJbgUSdS4nhzvVtli_30OMofZDo9h1gxDfMPqvp8OKnwAAAP__PlJ_wg), which runs the 141-room Global Ambassador hotel in Phoenix. _“It's time for me to focus on things that I own 100% of,”_ Fox said. The Global Ambassador was Fox’s first hotel, which [has won a Michelin Key every year since opening in December 2023](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2unDAURldjOiP8M3goXKShe2lTohv7GqwYG9l3IMzqozdbSP19Ojo6v76WL4gp5vUn7GgJ3mHJeLWERFgXX3KprcGJ7d6PreTbl0yh1EUOcuRC8OG5gKN44qKh81aNbjK6QyvMpIVWQulus24wyptxfEzSK6-N1pN56uA8KO8EQBftN0-I4SnU8FCyF37y8qH8byPEhNPI9IA-Uqk9bQg1vkuGkO5yYu1d2btkN6KjMfWDyZnJ-bquPrS6wwrvmPH7w-QcEOhVkckZAmHlofzlFRvBq0Im7kp2eFDjDfbPFhuHF22lxrxy4Bkv_idmz0vgW2lHJEiRbibnrlp_XDGl2EbD9LDuENNHjP636WnlvwAAAP__GVGQNQ). Fox has hinted at a smaller sister hotel in Phoenix. He and Justin Timberlake plan to open a second Twelve Thirty Club, their Nashville supper club, in Austin, Texas, in 2027.
## Donors Bring Phoenix Symphony Back
The Phoenix Symphony will return to the stage Nov. 12 after local donors [pledged enough money to lift the suspension](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uwyAUBeCnwRsRf8ZhYOjiLV07outwHaNisIA6TZ6-itU-Qed7dY6-83FxFwgxpNs7rGgbPGeX8F4jtobF-ZxyqRV2rI91W3J6-JzanIsTTGjKOWVnB9cWdnQKOm-lvppBdWj5YBRXkkvVLVZMg0ZgSg0z46B742cDvdQKJ9FPE3bBvvI4Z2cuWS_FiXvjRS_9NHBu0GiiGPrQcjm1BaGEZ04wx0fesZyuee2iXVrbKpFvRIxEjJ8NjgMR4-83fbGIGLclYwrf9A9EC9avFSutCDUnepDpFtHfsHbF-u0eYgxVD0Sx2wohHoXtv1vtVvwEAAD__9vYgfA) of its 2026-27 season. The orchestra stopped playing after Nov. 1 and [laid off its 66 musicians without pay](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAUBODT4AwLHrR_AoJNnPWmG1qvzbPNLgYLaHvbpx_1SDMXmLxU-qr-3Mc7Ou_C8hs3MgWveQx0Zk-lUBptDDHljAfl17avMbxsDGWOaQQBDZeSi27EqbiDRo2VNaqZ-lZXZGTba6mVVLpaDaG4AUoFbdshkiDd9TOBbRWK_iHmypl3n5Sik0rcFNTS9hZuyj5aKXvqG6YFWVdiqstKmNwVA87-FQ9K9RS3ypu1lD0z9YvBwGA4z7P-9_e66pgWBsPjmV2gnBkM3_CGwbCvkYL7z7_W8dN5zxPl50Z8pzTHtGGYKPNcMBUXFh7iwSVUydj9HXa5aZkWy4bOf0rKT088DHwEAAD__7G-iOo) the next day. The comeback opens with Brahms at the Musical Instrument Museum, then a Lloyd Webber, Elton John, and McCartney pops show Nov. 13-15 at Symphony Hall. The symphony hasn’t said how much it raised or who gave it. A musicians’ spokesperson said concerts will run through the end of the year, and fundraising must continue to carry the season into 2027. An 11-member commission, including two musicians, [will rework the orchestra's finances](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u4zAQhJ9G6mhoSeqvYHGNOl97pbAiVxYPFCmQGzn20wc2kLxA2sFgMN_37zpf0Qcfb39xJ8P4XOdI9xKImfLsUky5FDypPPZjS_HhUuQ15Vk2shMAohlmtOxPmjXWzqjOjr2uyUA_atAKlK43A9qCg4UUOJS9IliwXRytINHKAYfam9ceQDOAalolL-BGJ1vllh5gpLGrdEPOc8oX3gizf6aIa3ikk_LFpr0OZmM-SqX-VHKq5OT_v_NKTs4X-6pVcqLIlBl93Cmy-CHoxLEliv5TfEOKI2AswqZoKbPIxB85CkeW9oWyWBdHsLa6zsYddx-CL11f6ea2ow_vO_xbk6eRXwEAAP__EhmLSg) and operations. “ _Now we must build a financial and operating model that allows the Symphony to thrive, not simply survive from one season to the next,”_ said John Graham, the group’s co-leader.
## Screwworm Reaches Graham County
A pet dog near Thatcher is Arizona’s [fifth confirmed case of New World screwworm](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAUhJ_G7ojMj00oKG6TLrfd0jqBQ4wWQwRnbTlPv0q0xfZbjmY0o_k-rvMVYor5_h9WtATPMGfcW0IirLMvudTWYMN2rI-l5MOXTKHUWQxiYpyz4TyDo7jhrKD3Vk7OaNWj5dooriSXql-sxiloJ8YRnUcUQZ6FHr0Ohjtz42bqo331cT6cuRxGKU7cGy9G6W-ac4Nm6tSAPlKpJ1oQanyWDCEdZcN6cmXtk12IHq2T_zpx6cTlk-BtdOLyk2avW79kiIEW1lzFfS91ZQ4asnuFBVbmylemo6_WP_aYUmyT7tRwXyGm9xr9FdRmxXcAAAD__1JlgJY), and the first in Graham County. I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKP7BgUQnR1bSjbrqMTOJAVEhoEu68fsXMfYJu7eNj-zu_38wbhD3E9QccOK7pPE0u5gNdinWDJ2JM17olXzcsmIPhlOuWsZb2BmwNTzQSGjdK0FJr3eDIukEyKSnTzTZ67qzvUPTWOr9wxntQQLFXXjKlhW7CeBsyRnsmOGXywaXq6aIcLHahg1dEUnShpvy4b8tYgsNYA-wPm45mH7daz0LEN8JnwueC9sr4gIgu1VtB-FyvHENc2zOFWNurAOFzNyi_qA7bAQfRSnTQDoiiBd97r5ChRiBiLunKFo1NDomYvv98f__FVEdlR7i-6mEOdOE6iJjwgLC_il9DREwbZAfljwH799WycJwQ1kjEVM-rwBfCUI5PrC9RxXxbNnl050fY91B0RyRd7xWfT9f_jek58n8BAAD___2ho_k)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKP7BgUQnR1bSjbrqMTOJAVEhoEu68fsXMfYJu7eNj-zu_38wbhD3E9QccOK7pPE0u5gNdinWDJ2JM17olXzcsmIPhlOuWsZb2BmwNTzQSGjdK0FJr3eDIukEyKSnTzTZ67qzvUPTWOr9wxntQQLFXXjKlhW7CeBsyRnsmOGXywaXq6aIcLHahg1dEUnShpvy4b8tYgsNYA-wPm45mH7daz0LEN8JnwueC9sr4gIgu1VtB-FyvHENc2zOFWNurAOFzNyi_qA7bAQfRSnTQDoiiBd97r5ChRiBiLunKFo1NDomYvv98f__FVEdlR7i-6mEOdOE6iJjwgLC_il9DREwbZAfljwH799WycJwQ1kjEVM-rwBfCUI5PrC9RxXxbNnl050fY91B0RyRd7xWfT9f_jek58n8BAAD___2ho_k)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKP7BgUQnR1bSjbrqMTOJAVEhoEu68fsXMfYJu7eNj-zu_38wbhD3E9QccOK7pPE0u5gNdinWDJ2JM17olXzcsmIPhlOuWsZb2BmwNTzQSGjdK0FJr3eDIukEyKSnTzTZ67qzvUPTWOr9wxntQQLFXXjKlhW7CeBsyRnsmOGXywaXq6aIcLHahg1dEUnShpvy4b8tYgsNYA-wPm45mH7daz0LEN8JnwueC9sr4gIgu1VtB-FyvHENc2zOFWNurAOFzNyi_qA7bAQfRSnTQDoiiBd97r5ChRiBiLunKFo1NDomYvv98f__FVEdlR7i-6mEOdOE6iJjwgLC_il9DREwbZAfljwH799WycJwQ1kjEVM-rwBfCUI5PrC9RxXxbNnl050fY91B0RyRd7xWfT9f_jek58n8BAAD___2ho_k)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student's hands today?](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKP7BgUQnR1bSjbrqMTOJAVEhoEu68fsXMfYJu7eNj-zu_38wbhD3E9QccOK7pPE0u5gNdinWDJ2JM17olXzcsmIPhlOuWsZb2BmwNTzQSGjdK0FJr3eDIukEyKSnTzTZ67qzvUPTWOr9wxntQQLFXXjKlhW7CeBsyRnsmOGXywaXq6aIcLHahg1dEUnShpvy4b8tYgsNYA-wPm45mH7daz0LEN8JnwueC9sr4gIgu1VtB-FyvHENc2zOFWNurAOFzNyi_qA7bAQfRSnTQDoiiBd97r5ChRiBiLunKFo1NDomYvv98f__FVEdlR7i-6mEOdOE6iJjwgLC_il9DREwbZAfljwH799WycJwQ1kjEVM-rwBfCUI5PrC9RxXxbNnl050fY91B0RyRd7xWfT9f_jek58n8BAAD___2ho_k)**

Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines.

That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward.

That's how this movement actually scales.

Because the reality is, the demand is here now.

The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it.

And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward.

One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you.

If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now.

Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school.

clean_body: I want to give you a picture of what’s really happening right now | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. September alone, and 3.6% over the past year.

When prices climb, the dollars in your savings buy a little less food,
a little less at the pharmacy, a little less of everything you live
on.

label reading $100 in 2016 points to the left bag, full of bread,

Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh

Alongside the seat flips, Democrats picked up majorities in at least 12 chambers and broke at least 13 GOP supermajorities. I have sued Barack Hussein Obama before . . . and I beat him.

Obama's administration was running a bulk-surveillance program that swept up the telephone records of millions of Americans who had done nothing wrong and were suspected of nothing.

Congress held hearings about it.

The press wrote about it. Nothing changed, because nothing ever changes from a hearing or a column.

I took him to federal court and I got an injunction against the President of the United States.

That is the entire difference between complaining and filing, and it is the only reason you have heard of Freedom Watch.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABAE5QEaHmhFDw2DsMK7bKsJVjyjK-W8bn7RqJyq19hyAGd2LkveFVTk2H3Dw2AMLutSlAmjEULBur8JLijpnaARYH1lupbXpvlc1Wf6w
Help me do it again.

So when I tell you I intend to serve Barack Obama with a complaint, understand that I am not posturing. I have his number. I have done it before and I know exactly how long it takes and exactly what it costs.

Here is why he is back on my desk . . .

Obama went out on the road to campaign for Abdul El-Sayed, the Jihadist-Marxist Senate candidate in Michigan. Not a quiet endorsement in a press release.

The former President of the United States lent his name, his draw and his crowds to that disgraceful campaign in the closing stretch of the race.

Texas and Florida have each designated CAIR a terrorist organization at the state level, and members of Congress are pressing the federal government to follow. His own Republican opponent demanded he give the money back. He did not.

This is also the candidate who answered an attempted attack on a Michigan synagogue with a preschool inside it by saying ";hurt people hurt people.";

A former President of the United States looked at all of that and decided to get on a plane.

That is a choice, and choices have consequences.

My name is Larry Klayman. I founded Judicial Watch in 1994 and then Freedom Watch.

I am a former federal prosecutor. I exposed Filegate and Chinagate, I have sued the Iranian regime, Fidel Castro and Hugo Chavez on behalf of their victims, and I am the only lawyer in American history to obtain a court ruling that a sitting president had committed a crime.

I do not tell you that to boast. I tell you because the name Obama makes most lawyers in this country go quiet, and I need you to know that it has never once made me go quiet.

Nine American jurors heard the evidence and voted unanimously to return a True Bill of Indictment on seven felony counts against Barack Hussein Obama, Abdul El-Sayed, Hasan Piker, Zohran Mamdani, Ilhan Omar and Rashida Tlaib.

And the grand jury belongs to the people, not to the government. Justice Scalia wrote that for the Supreme Court in United States v. body:
Hey Peter, it's Scott.
I was born and raised in Mississippi. Growing up here, I never thought I would be locked in what is shaping up to be the closest Senate race in modern history.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261108-partner-sc.LTEM8M&amount=5&refcode=em20261108-1324&t=1&akid=1324%2E34582%2E7Ar4ZZ)
Getting here wasn’t easy.
But over the last fourteen months my campaign has traveled all across the state, speaking with every last voter we could find.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261108-partner-sc.LTEM8M&amount=5&refcode=em20261108-1324&t=2&akid=1324%2E34582%2E7Ar4ZZ)
We even spent some time talking to voters outside Trump’s Mississippi rally last month – _because that’s how you win in a state like this._
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261108-partner-sc.LTEM8M&amount=5&refcode=em20261108-1324&t=3&akid=1324%2E34582%2E7Ar4ZZ)
Along the way we’ve been funded by grassroots donations of $5, $10, even $50 at a time. And it means the world to me to know that so many people have my back.
But this race isn’t over yet.
We need to make sure that we stand up for the will of the voters from now until this is fully certified. In a state like Mississippi, we can’t afford to get complacent at the finish line.
Closing this race out is going to cost millions of dollars. This is going to be the most closely divided U.S. Senate race in modern American history.
**[So please. If you can afford to make a split donation of $5 to Small Town PAC and my campaign’s legal fund to help us stand up for voting rights, I hope you’ll donate today.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261108-partner-sc.LTEM8M&amount=5&refcode=em20261108-1324&t=4&akid=1324%2E34582%2E7Ar4ZZ)**

Let’s go win,
Scott Colom

proof of address.

ID.”

Then we left. WE NEVER SIGNED AN OATH. WE NEVER RECEIVED A BALLOT. WE

oath.”

Last week, days before the midterm elections, I wrote that the best thing Washington could do for markets was nothing. A divided government, with Congress controlled by Democrats, and the legislative paralysis that comes with it, would not necessarily be bad. For an overheated economy running on $6 diesel, 5% long bonds, and a stock market valued at well over twice GDP, the healthiest outcome might actually be gridlock.
On Tuesday, voters delivered exactly that. Democrats swept both chambers, flipping at least seven Senate seats, including Texas, where James Talarico beat Ken Paxton by 11 points. Kansas elected its first Democratic senator since 1932. It was the first time since Obama's second term that an incumbent president lost both chambers.
* * *
## [Good Gridlock](https://substack.com/redirect/35e01412-0936-4bdd-9304-b3975411a2f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| Nov 1
[](https://substack.com/redirect/35e01412-0936-4bdd-9304-b3975411a2f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[In the movie Wall Street, Gordon Gekko famously declares that "greed is good." But there is another g-word that the actual Wall Street might also love, and it isn't greed. It's gridlock. Not the kind on the Long Island Expressway or on Route 93 entering Boston at rush hour. The kind in Washington where one party holds the White House and the other holds...](https://substack.com/redirect/35e01412-0936-4bdd-9304-b3975411a2f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/35e01412-0936-4bdd-9304-b3975411a2f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
The Dow's first verdict was unambiguous: up 1,569 points on Wednesday, its best day since April 2025. Morgan Stanley put it simply: "Markets like gridlock." The market's fear index (the VIX) plunged 20%.
It lasted one day. On Thursday, the Dow plunged 1,833 points. The Nasdaq fell 5.5% into correction territory, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 12% in a session to lock in its fifth straight weekly decline. Wall Street's worst week since June arrived was the week it got the election result it had been rooting for.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/aabdb8b3-121a-4011-aa53-09e106d8f176?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Both days were telling the truth, about two different markets. **The market got what it wanted on Tuesday. Then it remembered what it owns.** Wednesday priced restraint in Washington, and most of the economy liked it. Thursday priced restraint in Abilene, Texas, and every other county where a data center was being built. Turns out the one sector that has been carrying the index did not like gridlock.
**The First Market**
Start with the market that rallied. The winners on Wednesday were the sectors Republicans had been targeting, or taxing, or simply ignoring:
* _**Solar**_**.** Tax credits that Republicans planned to kill by 2028 are now safe.
* _**Hospitals and insurers**_**.** Hopes that Democrats restore the expired ACA subsidies.
* _**Dollar stores**_**.** A belief that tariffs stop escalating and stop taxing working-class consumers.
* _**Bonds**_**.** A bet that a divided Washington cannot spend at prior rates. The 10-year fell to a four-week low.

This is the broad economy, the ninety percent that doesn't build chips or server farms. It has spent two years absorbing tariffs, record diesel, and a Fed that couldn't cut. For that market, a Washington that does nothing is a gift. No new trade wars, no new deficit-financed subsidies, no fresh shocks to price. A narrower range of policy outcomes is exactly what a consumer-facing business, a hospital, or a bond investor wants.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/223d0fa3-3e96-4346-96f3-0b6e4a58bb77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**The Second Market**
Now the market that fell. For two years a handful of chipmakers, hyperscalers and data center builders have carried the S&P 500. Strip them out and the index has gone roughly nowhere. Their earnings, their capital spending, and their multiples are what turned a stagflationary economy into a record stock market. This narrow strength concealed the economic weakness that led voters to evict politicians they blamed for the affordability crisis.
In reality, the AI trade was never a bet on Washington staying out of the way. It was a bet on Washington staying in the way, on the right side: federal subsidies, fast-tracked permits, pre-empted local zoning, and a White House that treated every gigawatt as a national security asset. Unified Republican government was the AI trade's policy tailwind. Thursday's market showed us what it looks like when a tailwind turns into a headwind.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0219419a-c484-4e46-b175-c3bc79cc1d95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In addition to chip and AI companies, other losers were the firms whose business model was proximity to power. Trump Media fell 25%. Tesla and SpaceX slipped on Wednesday, then fell 11% and 9% on Thursday. Musk poured over $150 million into the Texas Senate race and lost, and Texas going blue changes the landscape for the massive data center complex in Abilene. Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned on "an immediate moratorium on new data center construction." A Democratic Congress won't pass a national moratorium; Trump would veto it. It doesn't need to. The subsidies may stop and a slower and more expensive buildout is a valuation-adjusting change for a sector priced for faster and cheaper.
**So the sector most exposed to divided government is the sector the index can least afford to lose. Gridlock is good for most of the economy. The problem is that most of the economy isn 't what has been holding up the market.**
None of this is the French Revolution; nobody is lopping off heads. Trump still has the power to veto. Democrats lack a filibuster-proof majority. And that's precisely the point: the market isn't pricing in any sweeping legislation. It's pricing in **restraint** : no new tariff escalations, no more blank-check AI subsidies, and no more one-party fiscal policy that drives inflation and yields.
* * *
## [France on Fire (Again)](https://substack.com/redirect/c23ca810-fb77-495b-b23c-89df0a8b9a24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[In 1972, a journalist asked Chinese Premier Zhou Enlai about the impact of the French Revolution. His answer, the story goes, was, "It's too early to say." The line has become a staple of geopolitical commentary. It's a great reminder that revolutions unfold on very long timelines (and that the Chinese generally think about dynamics over the long-term c...](https://substack.com/redirect/c23ca810-fb77-495b-b23c-89df0a8b9a24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
The economy isn't fixed. Diesel is still near records, the Buffett Indicator remains very elevated, the Strait of Hormuz continues to be effectively closed, and the Fed is likelier to hike than cut. But Washington just took its foot off the accelerator, and the VIX, which spiked to 26 on Thursday, is again drifting lower.
That is what reduced uncertainty looks like. Not calm, but rather a narrower distribution of outcomes. The tail scenario where Washington starts a new trade war, a new real war, or a new trillion-dollar subsidy before 2029 has been largely cut off. But the tail where a bubble built on cheap money and policy favor deflates on its own schedule has not. One of those tails was always Washington's to control. The other never was.

body:
| | | It's Chuck Schumer.

Against all odds, Democrats have won the majority.

This is a generational remake of the Senate map. So far, we've managed to flip **_seven seats_** ‐‐ Iowa, Kansas, Maine, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, and Texas ‐‐ all while defending Michigan, New Hampshire, Georgia, and _every other Democratic ‐held seat._

**And we're not done yet:** Right now, the races in Alaska and Mississippi are still too close to call, and we could expand our new majority.

I have five words for the American people as we head into this new era: **Relief is on the way.**

You showed up to the polls to put a check on Donald Trump, his allies, and their agenda ‐‐ so my fellow Democrats and I are going to do our part. We are going to stand up to Trump's chaos, crack down on corruption, and work hard to drive down costs ‐‐ _the president can work with us if he chooses, or face another drubbing for his party in 2028._

This historic victory wouldn't have been possible without the support of dedicated Democrats like you. So from the bottom of my heart, thank you for showing up when it mattered, and for putting in the work to make our country a better place.

**Now, we need to keep this momentum going as we head into 2028. Republicans won't stop fighting, so we have to do everything in our power to defend the majority we worked so hard for.**

This historic victory wouldn't have been possible without the support of dedicated Democrats like you. So from the bottom of my heart, thank you for showing up when it mattered, and for putting in the work to make our country a better place. Now, we need to keep this momentum going as we head into 2028. Republicans won't stop fighting, so we have to do everything in our power to defend the majority we worked so hard for. Join us for a community call full of rest, reflection, and love notes | | | Peter, November is National Family Caregivers Month, a time to honor those who care for family members living with chronic illness, disability, or age-related needs. It’s also a reminder that caregiving can take a real toll on our mental health, and that the people who care for others deserve support, rest, and care of their own. And we know our community is full of caregivers. 💌 We’re the ones taking care of our parents and abuelitos, raising our siblings, and showing up for our loved ones. clean_body: Join us for a community call full of rest, reflection, and love notes | | | Peter, November is National Family Caregivers Month, a time to honor those who care for family members living with chronic illness, disability, or age-related needs. It’s also a reminder that caregiving can take a real toll on our mental health, and that the people who care for others deserve support, rest, and care of their own. And we know our community is full of caregivers. 💌 We’re the ones taking care of our parents and abuelitos, raising our siblings, and showing up for our loved ones. And this year, as this administration has torn through our neighborhoods, so many of us stepped up to hold our families together after a loved one was detained or deported. That’s why we’re coming together for** on Tuesday, November 10 at 7PM ET. subject: We asked you if it was time for new leadership…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Democrats just won a historic victory. But if party leaders think that
means they get to keep doing things the same old way, they haven't been
paying attention.

We asked Our Revolution members who should lead in this new era. 73% said
Chuck Schumer is NOT the right person to lead Senate Democrats. And 51%
said the same about Hakeem Jeffries in the House.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40007?source=email-20261108&t=1011&akid=11566%2E5885482%2Ep15UW9 ]Headline: Calls to Replace Jeffries and Schumer Explode After
Democratic Wins

That's a clear message from the grassroots: we need an open, public debate
about where the Democratic Party goes from here, and contested,
transparent elections to decide who leads the party.

Millions of us organized, volunteered, knocked doors, made calls, and
fought to win back the House and Senate and elect a new generation of
progressives. WE did the work to win — delivering a clear mandate for
change. WE should have a say in who leads the party.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40007?source=email-20261108&t=1012&akid=11566%2E5885482%2Ep15UW9 ]SIGN NOW: Tell Democrats there must be an open, competitive leadership
election — no coronations, no backroom deals.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40007?source=email-20261108&t=1013&akid=11566%2E5885482%2Ep15UW9 ]ADD YOUR NAME

The stakes couldn't be higher. Democrats have a chance to take on Trump's
corruption, challenge corporate power, lower costs for working families,
and deliver the bold agenda voters are demanding.

But that will take leaders willing to fight — not leaders who expect to
keep their jobs simply because they've held them before.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40007?source=email-20261108&t=1014&akid=11566%2E5885482%2Ep15UW9 ]Headline: ‘I’ll be reelected as majority leader,’ Schumer says

The day after the polls closed, Schumer announced: "I'll be reelected as
Majority Leader."

It’s not his call to make.

And this isn't just about Schumer or Jeffries. It's about whether the
party's direction will be decided by a handful of insiders or by a real
democratic process that gives every member of Congress a voice and every
faction of the party a chance to make its case.

We need a real leadership contest, not locked rooms, secret ballots, and
predetermined outcomes.

Our Revolution is organizing to make sure this historic moment doesn't get
squandered — and that the people who powered this victory have a voice in
what comes next.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40007?source=email-20261108&t=1015&akid=11566%2E5885482%2Ep15UW9 ]SIGN NOW: Demand open, competitive leadership elections in both the
House and Senate.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

body:
Both sides are in court
Both sides are in court

| | Peter, Both sides in Alaska’s Senate race went to court this week. Mary Peltola sued to count votes. Her campaign is demanding the state explain every rejected absentee ballot — whose vote was set aside, and why — because in a race decided by roughly 600 votes, a single tray of wrongly rejected ballots could be the whole outcome. Her filing says it plainly: she cannot ensure her voters’ lawful votes were counted without knowing which ones were questioned. Dan Sullivan and the national Republican committee stood up a recount fund on Election Day itself — before the count was even hours old. Add the DOJ’s appeal, still alive after a federal judge threw out its certification lawsuit, and their posture is clear: if the votes don’t go their way, fight the votes. One side fighting to make every ballot count. The other preparing to contest them. clean_body: Both sides are in court Both sides are in court | ~~ | | Peter, Both sides in Alaska’s Senate race went to court this week. Mary Peltola sued to count votes. Her campaign is demanding the state explain every rejected absentee ballot — whose vote was set aside, and why — because in a race decided by roughly 600 votes, a single tray of wrongly rejected ballots could be the whole outcome. Her filing says it plainly: she cannot ensure her voters’ lawful votes were counted without knowing which ones were questioned. Dan Sullivan and the national Republican committee stood up a recount fund on Election Day itself — before the count was even hours old. Add the DOJ’s appeal, still alive after a federal judge threw out its certification lawsuit, and their posture is clear: if the votes don’t go their way, fight the votes. One side fighting to make every ballot count. The other preparing to contest them. body:
To all of Scott Colom’s supporters: Please don’t click away from this important email.
This isn’t the first time we’ve reached out, so we’ll get right to it. We’re emailing to ask you to make a donation to help Scott Colom protect the will of the voters. The Mississippi Senate race is too close to call, and we need your help.
Unlike Cindy Hyde-Smith, Scott doesn’t depend on a handful of billionaires to bail out his campaign. We’re powered by grassroots donations of $5, $10, even $50 at a time. Just a little bit here and there from regular people, chipping in what they can afford, when they can afford to give.
It’s the right way to run a campaign. But it means that without emails like this one, we wouldn’t have a chance.
So while most people reading this won’t give, we’re really hoping that you’ll be different. If we’re going to make history and flip the Mississippi Senate seat, we’re counting on folks like you.

body:
| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ericconroy/new-poll-shows-that-the-race-for-oh-01-in-virtual-tie-4764363?e=3f87e575ad)

| | | | | |

Dear Friend,Thank you. I wanted to take this opportunity to thank each of you for the work you put into this campaign. I had never run for office before. For over a year, I crisscrossed this district every day, working to become your representative in Washington. This was a very challenging environment to run in down the ballot, and a difficult night for Republicans across Ohio and the nation. And while we came up short, we should be proud of the campaign we built.Together, we knocked on over 75,000 doors, made over 150,000 phone calls and reached people in every corner of the district. We put up over 7,000 signs across OH-01, building visibility and momentum not seen in years for a Republican campaign for this seat. We had the resources to compete, our campaign was able to raise over 2.5 million dollars, showing the best fundraising numbers by a Republican in OH-01 in numerous cycles. This campaign united Republicans across the country, opening for President Trump’s rally, hosting Vice President JD Vance at Price Hill Chili, Speaker Mike Johnson, NRCC Chairman Richard Hudson, along with other high-profile elected officials. Our support was unmatched. You hosted and attended events. You put out signs and knocked on doors. You supported me even when the district lines were in flux, and the media and many others thought we didn’t have a shot. I could not be prouder of the groundwork we laid.This is the beginning, not the end. The people of this district deserve better, and I hope the message we sent puts Greg Landsman on notice about his self-dealing and corruption. Peter, The Democrats’ sweeping success in the midterms showed that Americans are ready for a change. Voters rejected a status quo defined by corruption, endless war, and an economy that puts the Epstein class over the working class. They’ve entrusted us to move our country in a new direction. When Democrats take control of Congress in January, we must ask ourselves: What will we do with that mandate? I laid out my answer in a new [op-ed for MS NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143126457/659171949/1332635594?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTA3YmFkZGEtOWJkYi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNTQ0NDJlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KgoWKLt5fdSI_vXc6qmgkRFo__u7EpcUnc54Tv5sTuk=&emci=9d7badda-9bdb-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&emdi=a07badda-9bdb-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&ceid=9848080): **Democrats must deliver America's Next New Deal.**

That means: ✅ Medicare for All✅ Affordable childcare ✅ Good jobs in every community ✅ Taxing the billionaires✅ No more endless foreign wars Franklin D. Peter, this is Bobby Pulido. The last few days have been unreal. We defied the odds here in TX-15. Not by a small margin, but by a landslide. I didn’t plan to sell out tours or win a pair of Latin GRAMMYs. And I definitely didn’t plan to walk away from all of it to launch a campaign for Congress. But South Texas gave me a voice, and now I’m going to give South Texas a real voice in Washington. I see my own family in the people I meet across TX-15 every single day. My grandfather was a migrant farmworker. My father made a name for himself in Tejano music, a path I followed for 30 years. All along, we’ve known the movement we’re building will last for generations, because it’s built by the very people who make South Texas great. **Now I want to make sure those are the people reflected in my work.** **[So I want to know: What issues matter most to you and your family? We defied the odds here in TX-15. Not by a small margin, but by a landslide. I didn’t plan to sell out tours or win a pair of Latin GRAMMYs. And I definitely didn’t plan to walk away from all of it to launch a campaign for Congress. But South Texas gave me a voice, and now I’m going to give South Texas a real voice in Washington. I see my own family in the people I meet across TX-15 every single day. My grandfather was a migrant farmworker. My father made a name for himself in Tejano music, a path I followed for 30 years. All along, we’ve known the movement we’re building will last for generations, because it’s built by the very people who make South Texas great. Now I want to make sure those are the people reflected in my work. | | Thanks for everything. Gracias por todo. — Bobby | | Paid for by Bobby Pulido for Texas

Friend,

What happens when a gang takes over an entire prison?

In Venezuela, we found out.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTUsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABAGE35vwvAxBcwURY2vBhk6WiCmIgPeSAOCYBK7XYAHtu_68mwo01s9MDl0rTJ7YGZJL91uCBnOXen6msGf_rOBouCCFTDNQeQhicWlWtA

In the early 2010s, inside Tocoron prison in Aragua State, a gang seized control of the facility.

Its leaders ran the prison as their headquarters and used it as a launchpad for crime across the region.

They called themselves Tren de Aragua — TDA.

Today, that prison gang is a transnational criminal network operating across South America, Mexico, and, according to U.S. authorities, the United States.

The U.S. has designated it a Foreign Terrorist Organization. It deals in drugs, extortion, and fraud. And it traffics human beings.

Let me introduce myself.

My name is Jeff Tiegs.

I served as an Army Ranger, a Special Forces Green Beret, and a Delta Force officer, retiring as a Lieutenant Colonel.

Today I lead Rescue in Blue, an organization with a mission to train and equip local law enforcement — at home and internationally — to recognize trafficking, arrest predators, and rescue victims.

And right now, we have a rare window into how TDA operates.

Someone on the inside is talking, Friend.

For her safety, we call her Elena.

TDA recruiters brought Elena to Mexico with the promise of work and a debt she could never repay.

After years surrounded by the gang — and after surviving an attempt on her life this year — she escaped. Now she’s helping us.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTUsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAABAGE35vxR6FPoBs1DtSnlweid7yaLf5wrj4gMumCVwELNEyRQ6tDoxUFOvbxWCgvYvqXtBXUB8znQHj45AhtAIdv7MDm0I_maDx7RwQcCg
Help Train The Force

According to Elena, TDA recruits women from Venezuela and Colombia and controls them through debt.

It pays “rent” to local criminal groups for the right to exploit women on their streets.

It runs ATM-hacking and card-cloning schemes with skilled hackers — schemes she says have followed its members into the United States.

And it hides behind aliases, moving money through other people’s accounts.

These aren’t street thugs acting on impulse. They’re running a business — and the product is people.

Elena is working alongside one of our Undercover Rescue Operatives… a man we call Tracker.

Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**

Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **Because people like you chose to act, this rescue was possible.**

A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. Because people like you chose to act, this rescue was possible. Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. clean_body: These charges are nothing more than an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism and intimidate anyone who dares to expose wrongdoing. | | | | Fellow Patriot, Back in August, we published a****bombshell investigative report on voter vouching laws.We never cast a ballot. We never signed a voter oath.Yet now, fellow journalist Cam Higby and I are facing felony charges and possible JAIL TIME. Even the county prosecutor acknowledged that we never intended to vote.These charges are nothing more than an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism and intimidate anyone who dares to expose wrongdoing. But I refuse to back down. I've fought these battles before, and I'll fight this one too. Because this is about something much bigger than me. It's about the First Amendment, freedom of the press, and every American's right to question authority. Fellow Patriot, fighting criminal charges takes resources. And with freedom of the press at stake, I'm asking you to stand with us. | | | In Truth, James O'Keefe CEO, O'Keefe Media Group Foundation | | | | | | | | PO Box 2945 640 Clematis Street West Palm Beach, FL 33401
