subject: If you’ve been losing hope — read this
body:
If you ever doubted we could win America’s youth back from the Left...

| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuunDAQhp_GdCBfwOCCItIKKcWJIqVIiQZ7YEcB2_Flo7x9tNl9gtPO5RvN9__8WD-ATvLHN7hwppzXlFfa_4b6wA3RnyGTP-4hYkJwq-RSt0K0fFrBFnrg2kPj5kGKaZ8anMVoeqEHpXhzn7WdFJdO9Bsahf3merWN0gnFJ73rYWpofvKE4JMwYpCmU1xzJY1xbuSjxI31vEYHBTvymRxmG0KM4aRCNnchHc0530uJmakvTC5MLhltTdiBRxdKZ8PF5FJq8uSPNgbypa0ZmFxGM-zbMGJr0Ki2RwetQVQt7NO-DyhQIzC15FCTxdUGh0zdvv74LoZRCs2kruVaL3RUL6ZueAGd7-JrhanbHZKD_GsF-_vdsnBFoMMzdSuxZng5pHz99_oeKpieyCbNLv6h86SsR9bz43ni-VBTPhnTY5b_AgAA__8IxqLE)
---
| | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuunDAQhp_GdCBfwOCCItIKKcWJIqVIiQZ7YEcB2_Flo7x9tNl9gtPO5RvN9__8WD-ATvLHN7hwppzXlFfa_4b6wA3RnyGTP-4hYkJwq-RSt0K0fFrBFnrg2kPj5kGKaZ8anMVoeqEHpXhzn7WdFJdO9Bsahf3merWN0gnFJ73rYWpofvKE4JMwYpCmU1xzJY1xbuSjxI31vEYHBTvymRxmG0KM4aRCNnchHc0530uJmakvTC5MLhltTdiBRxdKZ8PF5FJq8uSPNgbypa0ZmFxGM-zbMGJr0Ki2RwetQVQt7NO-DyhQIzC15FCTxdUGh0zdvv74LoZRCs2kruVaL3RUL6ZueAGd7-JrhanbHZKD_GsF-_vdsnBFoMMzdSuxZng5pHz99_oeKpieyCbNLv6h86SsR9bz43ni-VBTPhnTY5b_AgAA__8IxqLE)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuunDAQhp_GdCBfwOCCItIKKcWJIqVIiQZ7YEcB2_Flo7x9tNl9gtPO5RvN9__8WD-ATvLHN7hwppzXlFfa_4b6wA3RnyGTP-4hYkJwq-RSt0K0fFrBFnrg2kPj5kGKaZ8anMVoeqEHpXhzn7WdFJdO9Bsahf3merWN0gnFJ73rYWpofvKE4JMwYpCmU1xzJY1xbuSjxI31vEYHBTvymRxmG0KM4aRCNnchHc0530uJmakvTC5MLhltTdiBRxdKZ8PF5FJq8uSPNgbypa0ZmFxGM-zbMGJr0Ki2RwetQVQt7NO-DyhQIzC15FCTxdUGh0zdvv74LoZRCs2kruVaL3RUL6ZueAGd7-JrhanbHZKD_GsF-_vdsnBFoMMzdSuxZng5pHz99_oeKpieyCbNLv6h86SsR9bz43ni-VBTPhnTY5b_AgAA__8IxqLE)
---
_But now, Friend, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

**[If you're able to, I hope you'll help send a kit to the next student who raises their hand to lead by making your gift to Turning Point USA today.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuunDAQhp_GdCBfwOCCItIKKcWJIqVIiQZ7YEcB2_Flo7x9tNl9gtPO5RvN9__8WD-ATvLHN7hwppzXlFfa_4b6wA3RnyGTP-4hYkJwq-RSt0K0fFrBFnrg2kPj5kGKaZ8anMVoeqEHpXhzn7WdFJdO9Bsahf3merWN0gnFJ73rYWpofvKE4JMwYpCmU1xzJY1xbuSjxI31vEYHBTvymRxmG0KM4aRCNnchHc0530uJmakvTC5MLhltTdiBRxdKZ8PF5FJq8uSPNgbypa0ZmFxGM-zbMGJr0Ki2RwetQVQt7NO-DyhQIzC15FCTxdUGh0zdvv74LoZRCs2kruVaL3RUL6ZueAGd7-JrhanbHZKD_GsF-_vdsnBFoMMzdSuxZng5pHz99_oeKpieyCbNLv6h86SsR9bz43ni-VBTPhnTY5b_AgAA__8IxqLE)**

---
Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Andrew Sypher** Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA
---

---
[ _**Support Turning Point USA**_](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuunDAQhp_GdCBfwOCCItIKKcWJIqVIiQZ7YEcB2_Flo7x9tNl9gtPO5RvN9__8WD-ATvLHN7hwppzXlFfa_4b6wA3RnyGTP-4hYkJwq-RSt0K0fFrBFnrg2kPj5kGKaZ8anMVoeqEHpXhzn7WdFJdO9Bsahf3merWN0gnFJ73rYWpofvKE4JMwYpCmU1xzJY1xbuSjxI31vEYHBTvymRxmG0KM4aRCNnchHc0530uJmakvTC5MLhltTdiBRxdKZ8PF5FJq8uSPNgbypa0ZmFxGM-zbMGJr0Ki2RwetQVQt7NO-DyhQIzC15FCTxdUGh0zdvv74LoZRCs2kruVaL3RUL6ZueAGd7-JrhanbHZKD_GsF-_vdsnBFoMMzdSuxZng5pHz99_oeKpieyCbNLv6h86SsR9bz43ni-VBTPhnTY5b_AgAA__8IxqLE)

**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Friend, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

**Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. **

You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back.

And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time.

_**Cliff 's Note:**_
##### Tuesday was a change election, won by candidates who ran around their party's leadership. Schumer and Jeffries answered it with the same caution as before. With Stephen Miller taking over as Trump's chief of staff Monday, Democrats need leaders built for a fight, and the caucus votes are where they can pick them.
##### [Join BAM for $70 annually and stay on top of all our political insights like this one](https://substack.com/redirect/857d5ad3-bba8-46f7-a190-8372b6191c8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
_**-- Cliff**_
* * *
_**by[Lawrence Winnerman](https://substack.com/redirect/f479870f-2ca7-4558-b8ff-6efda665efec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
One of the things I've learned over the years is that my political instincts--for being someone who is just an average guy, and not a consultant--are pretty good. For example,[ my prediction last week about how Election Day would turn out](https://substack.com/redirect/35ec3883-b9f3-4664-b2f2-91b39be3fe4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was pretty damn spot-on. Which is why, on Wednesday morning, the day after the biggest Democratic wave most of us have ever lived through, when Chuck Schumer stood outside the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee and took questions about the new senators who say they won't vote to keep him in charge, I had to shake my head in disbelief.
"The issue is not me," he told reporters. Then, a breath later: "I'll be reelected as majority leader."
Oh, god, please no, Chuck! Read the room!
That same day Peggy Flanagan, the senator-elect from Minnesota, said the opposite into a microphone: "I think it is time for new leadership." Not only do I think she's right--I think it's hubris and self-interest that keep Schumer and Jeffries striving for top jobs in a caucus that has out-evolved them both.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.tGZRrD-Bni8vz_ZkdlSXSo3GkhAe3eI9nvz9WhFDjpU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=224045543)
Look at what Tuesday ended up being. Democrats flipped AT LEAST seven Senate seats and won the House by a margin far bigger than anyone expected, with at least 254 (and maybe as many as 260) House seats in the next Congress. Texas sent a Democrat to the Senate for the first time since 1988. Kansas did it for the first time in nearly a century. And Republicans failed to flip a single Democratic office anywhere in the country, not one Senate seat, not one House district, not one governor's mansion. Y'all. Not a single blue anything flipped to red this election--not ONE.
That is a change election if ever there was one. Voters said so in every way a country can say it.
Then the two men who will run those majorities walked up to the podium and sounded exactly the way they did before anybody voted. Hakeem Jeffries called it "an American tsunami" and promised to find "bipartisan common ground with the other side of the aisle." Schumer ignored two questions about whether he'd touch the filibuster. And Jeffries went on MS NOW to tell us that "the American people don't want us to get even, they want us to get things done on their behalf." I mean, we DO want you to do things like pass a minimum wage hike, and also--trust me on this--we really, really want you to get even with these evil clowns, too. Don't make me choose!
By Friday morning, a Substack writer who posts as Ana Nomis had summed up the week better than any strategist on cable. She thanked Schumer and Jeffries for "dumping freezing water all over the first taste of hope I've had in a fucking DECADE."

| Team, Proposition 39 went DOWN. Donald Trump, his MAGA allies, and right-wing billionaires tried to make it harder for eligible Californians to vote. California voters firmly rejected their attack on our secure and fair elections. California Democrats stopped their voter suppression proposition with grassroots organizing. | | | Team, 435 has been the total number of representatives in the U.S. House of Representatives since the Permanent Apportionment Act of 1929. **Even as our country has grown in population from 123 million back then to 343 million now, the number of people in Congress has not changed**. You're just farther from your Congressional representative in the House than ever before (along with more than 761,000 others). Some in the country recommend tying the size of a Congressional district to the smallest state by population, which is currently Wyoming. I**f this were the case, the House would jump from 435 members to 575** , while your local Congressperson would represent only roughly 585,000 people -- roughly 200,000 fewer than today. We want to hear from voters in your area to get their feelings on the topic. **Will you take our one-question poll right away?**

clean_body: It's been the same size since 1929, yet our population has grown significantly| | | | | | | | | Team, 435 has been the total number of representatives in the U.S. House of Representatives since the Permanent Apportionment Act of 1929. Even as our country has grown in population from 123 million back then to 343 million now, the number of people in Congress has not changed. You're just farther from your Congressional representative in the House than ever before (along with more than 761,000 others). Some in the country recommend tying the size of a Congressional district to the smallest state by population, which is currently Wyoming. If this were the case, the House would jump from 435 members to 575 , while your local Congressperson would represent only roughly 585,000 people -- roughly 200,000 fewer than today. We want to hear from voters in your area to get their feelings on the topic. Will you take our one-question poll right away? | | | Team: Should we make Congress bigger to get better representation? | | Dear Friend who has common sense,I'm always going to stand with America.I'm always going to reject the extremes. I'm always going to reject Socialism.I'm always going to fight against the anti-American way of life.And this has enraged a lot of people in the media, in my party, and even former staffers --- disgruntled leakers who are viciously and anonymously attacking me. This is what happens when you put common sense and the wellbeing of the people you are supposed to represent ahead of party loyalty.But most of all, I think this is what happens when you clash with the Socialist movement "DSA!" that is hijacking the Democratic party. They want to...Abolish our bordersAbolish the electoral collegeAbolish IsraelAbolish the Senate and the Supreme Court (no, seriously, this is in the "DSA!" platform)That bad news is the "DSA!" crazies have gone from the political fringe to controlling one of America's major political parties—and onto ballots across the country.The good news is the hardworking, common-sense Americans I talk to every day still aren't buying it.I mean, a recent Rasmussen poll kind of proves it:71% of Americans reject socialism67% of Democrat voters reject socialism While 82% of Republican voters reject socialismBut here's the thing. The loudest voice in the room is often the one that looks the most powerful.And I've got to say, the "DSA!" voices in Washington are loud and getting louder. The media is their megaphone. Which is why you may be under the false impression that people really do want the "DSA!" and their extreme policiesNothing could be further from the truth.**[I'm standing up to them.](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=6207f2fd43ec40b8bb5bfcc33b8ad999&_e=xOfKgKieYeZOdBiivyZk8xafe3bralKJ4Oh_zpb5W4R6IZLmvx7gGjBlmeLVEaF2kLyJsWmLas913ivYl1EFyI5webbK-ZN5M_MbjhSmsLS5xKz5QZrg_sev8nMxbA8Vd35VRye6BTZ56pqepcVmlFJUd_9WSDbPrJDYAXuPTnTsM2HXAVWPpa6h9IW0yZynWebAWi6l_aO0OFiBiAGrLYfzktmaPQfup9yPKj5IrNVS049GScNZBh5QIreNUTqt506cqtSX38P3edbHgowasV5N7DBfmzfJ7BSeqe2uXR0aNmoBDo6nx_lEBZGGwJbUXeutScA33BjLSsAzVre8OQOWq5FQnqhxIj2EIuYq3PjwolxrSG-mVprcHeYX1mWnya6DOS9snRBShjnu8O8rg8aaKpounIcBbFdolPGvLuH5WXWOT6UP-2P2QmYjY8kNIAB8J2mv7KWSimNNjDkf-UqVucrZBBMDpUpBBb48W5Elm9-42PXbUvaC7XXq5zElorocTZNH-HxB5H4y8YThyYpoOlD2zlvoqCF0dIjoojLuhcLQZMwHumF1ZUcCwR9lvfZ4OpBU_zt7Kv0IPrnu9KSklf68WgCFDU_GnUY5i9bvRVwihXTOrb9EsMOj1A-A0DE2ijtaeSJz18-ddRTUkUOKD504YAh47lenOyoWn2OHGRjYy9YmZBAAybwwrboQ)** But sadly I'm pretty much alone on this side of the aisle.So, can I ask you a favor? You know, I recently stood in front of the iconic U.S. Steel Mill and recorded a video talking about how my friend Dave McCormick and I banded together with President Trump to save this facility and the larger steel industry. But I'm not backing down.Even though I know the media... the "DSA!"... and the party bosses... are going to try even harder to defeat me:
---
**"Fetterman Draws Shadow Primary From Democrats Eager to Replace Him: The Pennsylvania senator has long irked members of his own party" ~ Bloomberg**
---

I'm just a senator with a big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). If you see eye-to-eye with me, then I could sure use your help. The "DSA!" vision for Pennsylvania and for America is not a healthy one. I'm always going to reject Socialism.I'm always going to fight against the anti-American way of life.And this has enraged a lot of people in the media, in my party, and even former staffers --- disgruntled leakers who are viciously and anonymously attacking me. This is what happens when you put common sense and the wellbeing of the people you are supposed to represent ahead of party loyalty.But most of all, I think this is what happens when you clash with the Socialist movement "DSA!" that is hijacking the Democratic party. They want to...Abolish our bordersAbolish the electoral collegeAbolish IsraelAbolish the Senate and the Supreme Court (no, seriously, this is in the "DSA!" platform)That bad news is the "DSA!" crazies have gone from the political fringe to controlling one of America's major political parties—and onto ballots across the country.The good news is the hardworking, common-sense Americans I talk to every day still aren't buying it.I mean, a recent Rasmussen poll kind of proves it:71% of Americans reject socialism67% of Democrat voters reject socialism While 82% of Republican voters reject socialismBut here's the thing. The loudest voice in the room is often the one that looks the most powerful.And I've got to say, the "DSA!" voices in Washington are loud and getting louder. The media is their megaphone. Which is why you may be under the false impression that people really do want the "DSA!" and their extreme policiesNothing could be further from the truth. But sadly I'm pretty much alone on this side of the aisle.So, can I ask you a favor? Whatever your party affiliation is, can I ask you to stand with me against the daily barrage of hit-pieces But it will also send a message. It will show the truth that the "real numbers" are on our side here in Pennsylvania, as well as around the rest of America. You know, I recently stood in front of the iconic U.S. Steel Mill and recorded a video talking about how my friend Dave McCormick and I banded together with President Trump to save this facility and the larger steel industry. But I'm not backing down.Even though I know the media... the "DSA!"... and the party bosses... are going to try even harder to defeat me: "Fetterman Draws Shadow Primary From Democrats Eager to Replace Him: The Pennsylvania senator has long irked members of his own party" ~ Bloomberg If you'll stand with me today, I know we can show them that we're not backing down and that the real numbers are on the side of common sense and putting our country first.Thank you!John Fetterman P.S. - I'll bet you're more than a little surprised to get this email from me. So, I want to say thanks for setting aside party affiliation for a second and hearing me out. You see, I'm not a progressive. And I'm definitely not a Democratic Socialist. I'm just a senator with a big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). If you see eye-to-eye with me, then I could sure use your help. The "DSA!" vision for Pennsylvania and for America is not a healthy one. subject: There’s a reason this story mattered to Charlie
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

Your support does far more than just send you a book...

It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack.

Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God.

For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed.

And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives.

Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for.

He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly.

That's why your support matters.

It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Peter, Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Now's the time to restore faith in God and faith in America before another generation drifts even farther from both. And with you, Charlie's mission will reach further -- and touch more young lives -- than ever before. For Charlie, The Turning Point USA Team P.S. Peter, many young people leave home with a foundation of faith, only to have the culture chip away at it, piece by piece. JD Vance knows what that struggle looks like. name: DNC Headquarters
subject: How your support helped us flip the Senate
body:
Derek, this is historic. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/98055?t=1&akid=10243%2E22930333%2EddzDbJ)
---
Derek, **On Tuesday night, Democrats flipped the House and Senate _BLUE_. This is a historic moment — for the first time in years, Democrats won (and overperformed) in states like Texas, South Carolina, Ohio, Iowa, and Kansas, where Donald Trump won in 2024 by _double digits._** **Derek,_none of this would have been possible without your support this year.**_ Here’s how we put it to work across the country: Early last year, the DNC committed to investing into _every single state Democratic Party, every single month_ to make sure they had the resources to hire and train organizers to fight and win up and down the ballot. **For the past two years, the DNC has sent over a million dollars every month to our state parties, including extra funding to longtime Republican-held states to ensure we compete everywhere.** **These investments were made possible _directly_ by your support.** Because of _your_ support, Democrats were able to run winning campaigns nationwide and place a massive check on Donald Trump’s agenda by flipping the House and Senate. Your support helped elect James Talarico in Texas, Adam Hamilton in Kansas, Annie Andrews in South Carolina, and Sherrod Brown in Ohio. **_These were the four seats we needed to flip this year.**_ This is a historic moment, so take a second to feel it, celebrate it, and enjoy it. But we also need to remember that the fight to take back the White House in two years starts _right now_. [**Derek, this team has _always_ stepped up when it’s important. Can we count on you to chip in $7 today to power our work to win back the White House in 2028 and continue building the critical infrastructure we need to keep electing Democrats up and down the ballot for years to come?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.gb4rMu&refcode=em_20261108_10243_fr&amount=7&t=6&akid=10243%2E22930333%2EddzDbJ) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89866?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.9s4leO&amount=7&refcode=em_20261108_10243_fr&t=7&akid=10243%2E22930333%2EddzDbJ)**

The call came from a hospital.

A teenage girl had been brought in after passing out. The man who brought her in said he had no idea what was wrong.

He was her father.

The nurses examined her.

**What they found told them everything. **

Friend, my name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_.

That film moved millions of people to ask, "_What can I do_?"

**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to answer that question, by helping stop the sale of God's children.

I want to tell you about this girl, because her story shows exactly what it takes to save a child.

**Her name is not Lyra, but this is her true story.**

Lyra grew up in a home where NO ONE kept her safe.

Her mother let the men she brought home hurt her little girl. Then those men brought their friends.

For years, Lyra was abused and trafficked inside her own home.

Through all of it, she never stopped going to school. She was a straight-A student who dreamed of a better life.

At twelve, she found out where her father lived. She ran to him, believing everything would finally change.

**It only got worse**.

Her father began abusing her too. _Then he handed her over to other men. _

A couple of years later, that hospital called one of the rescue partners we support.

Police officers escorted our partner to a small private room in the back, where Lyra was waiting.

"I sat beside her," our partner told me, "and slowly, she began to trust me."

Then the tears came, and the whole story came out.

_But getting her out safely was another matter. _

**Traffickers do not let go of a child easily. Many would rather take a child 's life than let her escape and tell the truth. **

So when Lyra was released, they did not use the front door.

They walked down a long hospital hallway... slipped through the back doors... and into a hidden car.

**That day, Lyra was free.**

And that was only the beginning.

Our partner brought her home, protected her, and raised her - for years.

She kept studying. She graduated. Then she graduated again.

**Friend, today, Lyra is a practicing nurse.**

The little girl who spent her childhood being hurt by others grew up to become a woman who brings healing to others.

Our partner describes this work in three words:

**Rescue. Restore. Raise. **
---
Help Rescue the Next Child Like Lyra
---
Friend, you care about protecting children. Before you trust anyone with that, you deserve to know who they are.

**So here is who we are. **

**We were born from a film that moved millions**. In 2023, Sound of Freedom brought the hidden reality of child trafficking into theaters across America and around the world.

Sound of Freedom Foundation was created to turn that awareness into action.

**We fight trafficking on five fronts** :
---
* **Prevention** : helping impoverished families most at risk, before traffickers can reach their children
* **Intervention** : supporting the agencies and partners who rescue trafficked children
* **Education** : giving parents and children the warning signs
* **Information** : using media to bring trafficking out of the shadows
* **Influence** : pressing governments and leaders for laws that put traffickers behind bars

---
**We stand with proven partners on the front lines.** These include House Parent Project, which has given rescued and vulnerable children a safe home for more than two decades; Safe House Project, which provides emergency services and training in the U.S.; and For Freedom International, which leads investigations and aftercare in Southeast Asia.

**And we have seen the results.** Five little sisters rescued after one stranger made one phone call. A baby recovered from a trafficker's apartment minutes before she could disappear forever.

_And now, Lyra._

Friend, rescue is never just one moment.

It is the hospital room, the back door, the hidden car... and then years of meals, schoolwork, counseling, and people who stay.

**That is what your gift makes possible**. The prophet Isaiah wrote:

"_He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners._ " (Isaiah 61:1)

Tonight, somewhere, another girl is in a place that should be safe... and isn't.

Someone needs to get her out. Someone needs to stay.

**[Friend, will you join us with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, or whatever God puts on your heart to help rescue, restore, and raise the next child like Lyra?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=dd73acba9038413a94e06d2a052c41bf&_e=bVpenZxC8Jzug7wRBt0AX8hB1enUr3PAGstp00N3nx_mth7dWSMaPF92vCtsvFnlqfNPaUp8wmJm_mDOyt6Jq6IAdPkqJk1qRfKV_CZaIymxgr5CfvUf_Zh4F_Ees5hCPo-Ll-zpky2RqtFze0l88xtDed3RHaScUhQ3igLLKQe-cY4JZyk8zJd1GyvaGtaZjV5MY1DGHMiVrOPhoyGCoi0hW09S_zoUVCQaKUCTPrZZE8N1VxGMMdey_u2sI7czTZL_fTGWEq1qNEdlowWLfyYOkaGM1o6ywc4MwXCdrXNHYZDF7bcXlv1C51eGjq0IcGUhbgqN7XaJgTlE9p_orOmqBfMjtsWhjWd3td16dK6tsvavKFpkON3QUZG2GoYJTV8bbliHaeAJ_OwmLdytUy_aJliM4mGQZ0Ke1nKK8OsLMPFW_-ZHGT8bS5G8yHs5N_tedTitbYYAVIYg99xa_kub81tqr-8iTEkDyV1DvS923tox0_H7Ubd9O4S9Dzn8WOF9olxvYL1ldbDb1lv89b6_3Y7fgRO4T9sk74tVML2Nq6TBYEYUQi80DlVzEE_8YG1inLhMgWuxOY0OCXwlz8L2DzM6Y-efIdy4fLPIf3EIGaDd3da-ntCD9rOHjJBsxegPcegq7H7VLmhFuDLtKGd2Mpheb1yyNS_zXZxr8ys%3D) **
---
Yes, I'll Help Rescue the Next Child Like Lyra
---
The men who hurt Lyra wanted her silent.

Today, she has a voice, a calling, and a future.

I would be honored to have you stand with us.

**God 's children are not for sale.**

| | | | Fellow Patriot, **[I was just charged with TWO FELONIES for my undercover journalism in Minnesota.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=6c26d7527f2a4ecda2f7094f37b5c513&_e=w1X5a1yjtFsA1NwuI47YTUzs5RzBjHNDozXYEL7usM_gq9xwd5M7dL0kv2ECnlhT7k2mx2t-wC0mB7S83lFMEc2kq9VjkBlE9Cb43Brp_TMXuzsg00qIxEbGcrvMdDfFU3wrFhTEIQIu6U8XsSho27OfDs5-j5wZfw7m7pZ9UGN3uMIXnDpy6JrWtH36dJ8QOtertkvdGUqp3_Mj5cep0Iclqk2sWja1qlGDT1Jfv3zf8Lqd4hQmjyJ1xQaWFpY6zD2fMHN3erVdjyHTrEBK3K0ziS-7WaTZgcVi8Ir0lZkXmRLze3VewYI3E82zStw-QK-nECQvW9IUhmSqs3NA1k-O-VxZHh0nvG3hUeDehwvXTZC-4iAX1hgYlLV2edXCrJXGYVyFHxO2ICvKv-epdUKUlPomI0B5WTogRCYQmn5knaBlEBZvhG7TBKFkQo7TelOVF9KnRkKiv9HGvzigFHBG-eEnnISJQfiVj-ikgzSuFlaUQwfGrqcW36zvig0DPR4Pmkoh4k1FJ3dWBG5PUPqUf5AVuZef4vUAAbgFCqz9BPMqedGG6HIz3S-_LQSQQJ21BubqhnCJfnGzers8vXuoTRWEm8CnJUrZ7rQ5Pp4%3D)** **Back in August, we published a********bombshell investigative report on voter vouching laws****.****We never cast a ballot. We never signed a voter oath.Yet now, fellow journalist Cam Higby and I are facing felony charges and possible JAIL TIME. Even the county prosecutor acknowledged that we never intended to vote.These charges are nothing more than an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism and intimidate anyone who dares to expose wrongdoing. But I refuse to back down. I've fought these battles before, and I'll fight this one too. Because this is about something much bigger than me. It's about the First Amendment, freedom of the press, and every American's right to question authority. Fellow Patriot, fighting criminal charges takes resources. Finally, A Weekend With My Wife Tracy
---
|
---
Finally, I had a weekend with my wife Tracy. After months of being completely locked in on the campaign, it felt good to slow down and just be together.
This race was especially hard. Just days before Election Day, I lost my father. He was my hero, my inspiration, and one of my strongest supporters. I know he was cheering me on, and I wish more than anything he could have been here to celebrate this win with us By the grace of God, we won.
Redistricting and a primary challenge drained a huge amount of our time and resources, but they never shook my determination to fight for Virginia's 5th District. We held a targeted seat in the middle of a Democratic wave, faced a well funded opponent, and watched outside groups pour millions into defeating us.
$4.5 million worth of BS lies about me on TV tricked many and almost did us in, but thanks to you amazing people, we got the win.
Again, we did it with relatively little money left in the account after a hard-fought campaign that took me all over the district and kept me away from Tracy far too often. I'm deeply grateful to [Ramona Christian for VA-05 District Chair](https://eky6fg9ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0017TDYB5XeWwG2jLL-6K7VUH1kaA4KH_gxKbsBlefRllanQUP8ul7xfIb3Cds80KojxaEAGpqmvBJ4KVCnISFthZ-FGywMmM4aOEWF-GCIp_q5_yFRxFwov9pe2xYuZ1Vney3n31aBq0Rf74eqdtBM71ywpnD6-0l01bhT5rSrCPuFQivVsjlUt0WgY5P8YPZT60epLt8K2uvOsIsxQALkhsgX5LfzQiqkcKivzZK59ywx7qLS0-urIgcu4YqlrELUNAaiK_t1FddZMsSFu9Aj6elhkRz_iChEZXbkxLDcj09Ibe3c3MG6Vhvp_Nh5FdCwpUQKVK01GSQTumgMv-LxX-mlBD4v5jQB55OIg3Bz04uVDq52_Ah9VpUnm86SVhgCByDs84WCJqIW5Fstw7WmiwODmuPfHYg_udh2Nrd9C8LdcGOQqIX-4cEk58FkcMsTVMbqt8E6PxPWp77z_jdmfqIlRwW2Rbfh&c=bzuydX8n707fNZoMHVgPw64VuuOp_rV4BGNyODRhxvWaWM0XSBIJdA==&ch=rhNcZ9PJWTDcQfttRXLcQy6DG2f89_H4uadfNGqQNq2Ozfm5GrV8cA==), my campaign manager Ryan Brown, and everyone who knocked doors, made calls, donated, prayed, and voted. This victory belongs to you too. And I'm especially thankful for Tracy's patience, sacrifice, and steady support through it all.
Now it's time to get back to work. The next several weeks still matter. In the remaining days of this Republican Congress, the House should not go home, not for Thanksgiving, not for Christmas, not for New Year's. Starting Monday, we should stay in Washington and work every day until the next Congress is sworn in.
We have important work left to finish:
✅ Balance the budget ✅ Pass meaningful permitting reform to unleash American energy and create jobs ✅ Strengthen election security and protect the integrity of our elections ✅ Pass the SAVE America Act ✅ Pass the National Defense Authorization Act so our military remains the strongest in the world ✅ Pass H.R. 9773 to codify border security, asylum, and parole reforms ✅ Advance another reconciliation package
The American people are tired of excuses. They want more jobs, lower costs, a government that lives within its means, and leaders who actually deliver. We still have time in this Congress to get results. Let's use every day of it and get it done.

Leadership Elections On Tuesday
---
We thank Speaker Mike Johnson for his dedicated service and tireless efforts on behalf of our conference. As he steps down, the House Republican Conference will hold leadership elections on Tuesday.
Here is the current field for House Republican Conference leadership positions for the 120th Congress, based on announcements following the 2026 midterms:
Minority Leader

* Steve Scalise (Louisiana) -- current Majority Leader
* Jim Jordan (Ohio) -- House Judiciary Committee Chair

(Speaker Mike Johnson has said he will not seek the minority leader post.)
Minority Whip

* Tom Emmer (Minnesota) -- current Majority Whip (seeking to retain the role)
* August Pfluger (Texas) -- Republican Study Committee Chair (challenging Emmer)
*

Conference Chair

* Lisa McClain (Michigan) -- current Conference Chair (running for re-election)
* Erin Houchin (Indiana)
* Greg Steube (Florida)

This is a three-way race.

clean_body: | | | | == | Thank You! Finally, A Weekend With My Wife Tracy | Finally, I had a weekend with my wife Tracy. After months of being completely locked in on the campaign, it felt good to slow down and just be together. This race was especially hard. Just days before Election Day, I lost my father. He was my hero, my inspiration, and one of my strongest supporters. I know he was cheering me on, and I wish more than anything he could have been here to celebrate this win with us By the grace of God, we won. Redistricting and a primary challenge drained a huge amount of our time and resources, but they never shook my determination to fight for Virginia's 5th District. We held a targeted seat in the middle of a Democratic wave, faced a well funded opponent, and watched outside groups pour millions into defeating us. $4.5 million worth of BS lies about me on TV tricked many and almost did us in, but thanks to you amazing people, we got the win. Again, we did it with relatively little money left in the account after a hard-fought campaign that took me all over the district and kept me away from Tracy far too often. I'm deeply grateful to ==, my campaign manager Ryan Brown, and everyone who knocked doors, made calls, donated, prayed, and voted. This victory belongs to you too. And I'm especially thankful for Tracy's patience, sacrifice, and steady support through it all. Now it's time to get back to work. The next several weeks still matter. In the remaining days of this Republican Congress, the House should not go home, not for Thanksgiving, not for Christmas, not for New Year's. Starting Monday, we should stay in Washington and work every day until the next Congress is sworn in. We have important work left to finish: ✅ Balance the budget ✅ Pass meaningful permitting reform to unleash American energy and create jobs ✅ Strengthen election security and protect the integrity of our elections ✅ Pass the SAVE America Act ✅ Pass the National Defense Authorization Act so our military remains the strongest in the world ✅ Pass H.R. 9773 to codify border security, asylum, and parole reforms ✅ Advance another reconciliation package The American people are tired of excuses. They want more jobs, lower costs, a government that lives within its means, and leaders who actually deliver. We still have time in this Congress to get results. Let's use every day of it and get it done. Leadership Elections On Tuesday We thank Speaker Mike Johnson for his dedicated service and tireless efforts on behalf of our conference. As he steps down, the House Republican Conference will hold leadership elections on Tuesday. Here is the current field for House Republican Conference leadership positions for the 120th Congress, based on announcements following the 2026 midterms: Minority Leader Steve Scalise (Louisiana) -- current Majority Leader Jim Jordan (Ohio) -- House Judiciary Committee Chair (Speaker Mike Johnson has said he will not seek the minority leader post.) Minority Whip Tom Emmer (Minnesota) -- current Majority Whip (seeking to retain the role) August Pfluger (Texas) -- Republican Study Committee Chair (challenging Emmer) Conference Chair Lisa McClain (Michigan) -- current Conference Chair (running for re-election) Erin Houchin (Indiana) Greg Steube (Florida) This is a three-way race.
